eval: 'NOTE: package walk-through of the panels, written against the stubs: it prints job states and checks nothing (prep-feeders stays open here because the real pans fill over farm time and this file sets fields the farm owns). The acceptance runs with the real farm are scripts/p2-level1.json and scripts/p2-level1-find.json.'

__game.stop(), window.__click = (t) => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel:not([hidden]) button, .panel:not([hidden]) label')].find((x) => x.offsetParent !== null && x.textContent.trim().startsWith(t)); if (!b) return 'NOT FOUND ' + t; b.click(); return 'clicked ' + t; }, window.__prep = () => __game.jobs().filter((j) => j.key.endsWith('@-1')).map((j) => j.key.replace('@-1', '') + ':' + j.status).join(' '), 'loop stopped, helpers set'

__game.startLevel({ seed: 1 }), __game.farm.litter.cover = 0, __game.farm.feed.lines.forEach((l) => { l.flood = false; l.panFill = 0; }), __game.farm.water.lines.forEach((l) => { l.flushClear = 0; }), 'mode ' + __game.level.mode + ', day ' + __game.env.dayNumber + ' ' + __game.env.timeLabel + ', jobs ' + __game.jobs().length
for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) document.querySelector('.ctrl .key[aria-label^="Raise the brooder"]').click(); 'setpoint ' + __game.env.heaterSetpoint + ', heaters on ' + __game.env.heatersOn

[...document.querySelectorAll('.ctrl-tab')][1].click(); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) document.querySelector('.ctrl .key[aria-label="One second more"]').click(); __click('Send this setting to the timer') + ', timer ' + JSON.stringify(__game.env.ventTimer)
'clock with the barrow: ' + __game.env.timeScale + ' game s per s'

const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { __game.ui.openPanel('drinker-' + i); for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) document.querySelector('.panel:not([hidden]) .key[aria-label="Winch: one step down"]').click(); out.push(__game.farm.water.lines[i].heightCm); } out.join(',') + ' cm set; ' + __prep()
__game.farm.feed.lines.forEach((l) => { l.flood = true; l.panFill = 1; }), __click('Read the feed meter')
__game.farm.water.lines.forEach((l, i) => { l.flushing = true; l.flushClear = 0.35 + i * 0.2; }), 'tubes clearing'
